# ProgressRing

`ProgressRing` — a determinate ring for a known amount of progress in a small slot. `value` is a percent (0 to 100); the drawn arc and the announced `aria-valuenow` clamp together to 0 to 100. A ring is never indeterminate; unknown time is `Spinner`'s job.

**Import:** `import { ProgressRing } from '@/components';`

**Source:** `design-system/src/components/loading/ProgressRing/ProgressRing.jsx`

**Stories:** `design-system/src/components/loading/ProgressRing/ProgressRing.stories.jsx` — Overview, Default, Inverse, Zero, Partial, Complete, Values, Sizes, Size16, Size20, Size24, WithInlineText, OutOfRangeValuesAreClamped, Interactive, Rest, Hovered, Pressed, Focused, ReducedMotion

**Motion:** change `linear`. Read the tokens through `--ds-motion-*`; see Foundations › Expression › Motion.

## Usage

Use `ProgressRing` when a task has a known percent done and sits in an
icon-sized slot, such as an uploading file row where a list of horizontal bars
would crowd the view. A ring is never indeterminate.

### Appearance guidance

| Appearance | When to use |
| --- | --- |
| Default | Standard surfaces: a brand-bold fill on a neutral track. |
| Inverse | On a bold or colored background. |

## Motion

ProgressRing reads these motion tokens and no literal duration or curve.

| Event | Transition | Tokens | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| change | Load content | `--ds-motion-linear` | Fills clockwise from twelve o'clock with the work, never ahead of it. |

## Alternatives

- For a wait whose duration is unknown, use `Spinner`.
- For progress where a horizontal track fits (such as a card header or a form step), use `ProgressBar`.
- For content loading into a layout that already has a shape, use `Skeleton`.

## Best practices

### Keep `ProgressRing` determinate and reach for `Spinner` when the total is unknown. {#keep-progressring-determinate-and-reach-for-spinner-when-the-total-is-unknown}

A ring with a track promises a known share of completion; spinning or freezing a
half-filled ring when there is no total misleads the tutor about how long is
left.

Do: Spinner when the wait has no measurable percent.
Don't: A fixed ProgressRing faking an unknown wait.

### Pair `ProgressRing` with visible percent text when exact progress matters. {#pair-progressring-with-visible-percent-text-when-exact-progress-matters}

At `PROGRESS_RING_SIZES` diameters (`16`, `20`, `24`), the center of the ring
cannot hold text; put the percent beside it on the row's meta line.

Do: The percent sits beside the ring.
Don't: A bare ring with no surrounding context.

### Match `size` from `PROGRESS_RING_SIZES` to the icon slot it replaces. {#match-size-from-progressringsizes-to-the-icon-slot-it-replaces}

Use `size={20}` in a row's leading slot so swapping between a status icon and
an active upload never shifts the row, and `size={16}` beside compact text.

Do: A ring sized to match the row's leading icon slot.
Don't: An undersized ring that shifts when replaced by the row's icon.

### Use `appearance="inverse"` on bold surfaces. {#use-appearance-inverse-on-bold-surfaces}

The neutral track disappears against a bold ground; `inverse` switches the track
and fill to inverse roles that stay legible.

Do: Inverse appearance on a bold surface.
Don't: Default appearance lost against a brand-bold fill.

## Accessibility

- **Announced as a determinate progressbar.** Renders `role="progressbar"` with
  `aria-label` set from the required `label` prop, `aria-valuemin="0"`,
  `aria-valuemax="100"`, and `aria-valuenow` clamped to `0`–`100` together with
  the drawn arc.
- **Name each ring distinctly in a list.** When several file rows upload at the
  same time, include the item's name in `label` so screen-reader users can tell
  one progressbar from another.
- **Decorative SVG.** The inner `<svg>` is marked `aria-hidden="true"` and
  `focusable="false"` so assistive technology reads only the progressbar role
  and its value.
- **Reduced motion.** Under `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`, changes to `value`
  update the arc immediately without animating `stroke-dashoffset`.

## Related

- `ProgressBar`: use when there is horizontal space for a full-width track, such as a card header or a multi-step flow.
- `Spinner`: use when a wait has no known duration or percent to report.
- `Flag`: use when a background upload completes and needs a brief confirmation notice.

Same group: `GenerativeBorder` · `ProgressBar` · `Skeleton` · `Spinner`

## Parts

1. **Track.** The full neutral circle behind the arc, drawn with a `--progress-ring-stroke` stroke.
2. **Fill.** The clockwise brand-bold arc starting at twelve o'clock, rounded at its ends and hidden when `value` is `0`.
3. **Accessible name.** The `label` prop set on the `progressbar` element via `aria-label`.

### States

| State | What changes |
| --- | --- |
| Zero | `value` is `0`: only the neutral track draws, and `aria-valuenow` is `0`. |
| Partial | `value` between `0` and `100`: the brand-bold arc fills clockwise from twelve o'clock with round caps. |
| Complete | `value` is `100`: the brand-bold arc closes the ring, and `aria-valuenow` is `100`. |
| Hovered | None. It is not a control. |
| Pressed | None. |
| Focused | None. It is not in the tab order. |

### Tokens

| Part | Token |
| --- | --- |
| Stroke width | `--progress-ring-stroke` across all sizes. |
| Size | `--icon-md` for `16`, `--image-xs` for `20`, `--icon-lg` for `24`. |
| Default | Track `--ds-background-neutral`, fill `--ds-background-brand-bold`. |
| Inverse | Track `--ds-background-inverse-subtle`, fill `--ds-icon-inverse`. |

## Content guidelines

| Do | Don't |
| --- | --- |
| Name what is progressing in `label`: "Uploading session-recording.mp4". | Use a generic "Progress" label when several rows upload at once. |
| Keep visible status text concise beside the ring: "Uploading · 64%". | Place numbers inside the ring itself. |

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| `value` | number (required) | — | Percent complete, from 0 to 100 |
| `size` | enum | `20` | Diameter in pixels: 16, 20 or 24 |
| `label` | string (required) | — | Accessible name describing what the ring measures |
| `appearance` | enum | `'default'` | default draws a brand fill on a neutral track; inverse reads on a bold background |
| `className` | string | `''` | Extra class names on the root element. |
| `id` | string | — | Element id on the root progressbar. |
